sections.title: Production Checklist
sections.body:
Use this to ensure production readiness:

### Phase 1: Local Development
- [ ] Model trained and serialized (Topic 129)
- [ ] REST API working locally (Topic 130)
- [ ] Docker container builds (Topic 137)
- [ ] Unit tests passing

### Phase 2: Infrastructure
- [ ] Kubernetes manifests created (Topic 141-143)
- [ ] CI/CD pipeline set up (Topic 144-145)
- [ ] Monitoring configured (Topic 149-151)
- [ ] Feature store implemented (Topic 148) *if needed*

### Phase 3: Optimization
- [ ] Model optimized (quantization/pruning) (Topic 131)
- [ ] Load testing completed
- [ ] Async inference if needed (Topic 130D)
- [ ] Autoscaling configured (Topic 143)

### Phase 4: Advanced Features
- [ ] gRPC for microservices (Topic 130B) *if needed*
- [ ] Kafka streaming (Topic 132B) *if needed*
- [ ] WebSocket real-time (Topic 130C) *if needed*
- [ ] ML pipeline orchestration (Topic 146/146B)

### Phase 5: Production Deployment
- [ ] A/B testing strategy (Topic 133)
- [ ] Canary deployment (Topic 135-136)
- [ ] Monitoring dashboards (Topic 149-151)
- [ ] Security & compliance (Topic 157-160)
- [ ] Documentation complete

sections.title: Technology Stack Quick Reference
sections.body:
### Communication Protocols
```
REST     → Topic 130  → Human-readable, easy debug
gRPC     → Topic 130B → High performance, 7-10× faster
WebSocket→ Topic 130C → Real-time, bidirectional
Kafka    → Topic 132B → Event streaming, high throughput
```

### Model Optimization
```
Quantization → INT8, 4× smaller, 2-4× faster
Pruning      → Remove 50-80% params, minimal loss
ONNX Runtime → Cross-platform optimization
TensorRT     → NVIDIA GPU acceleration
```

### Orchestration
```
Airflow  → Mature, large ecosystem, DAG-based
Prefect  → Modern, Python-native, dynamic flows
Kubeflow → Kubernetes-native, ML-specific
```

### Feature Stores
```
Feast  → Open-source, Redis online store
Tecton → Commercial, advanced features
```

### Monitoring
```
Evidently AI → Data drift detection
Prometheus   → Metrics collection
Grafana      → Dashboards
```

sections.title: Decision Trees
sections.body:
### Which Communication Protocol?

```
Need low latency (<10ms)?
├─ YES → Consider gRPC (Topic 130B) or WebSocket (Topic 130C)
└─ NO  → REST is fine (Topic 130)

Need real-time bidirectional?
├─ YES → WebSocket (Topic 130C)
└─ NO  → REST (Topic 130) or gRPC (Topic 130B)

Microservices communication?
├─ YES → gRPC (Topic 130B)
└─ NO  → REST (Topic 130)

Event-driven architecture?
└─ YES → Kafka (Topic 132B)
```

### Which Orchestration Tool?

```
Need dynamic workflows?
├─ YES → Prefect (Topic 146B)
└─ NO  → Airflow (Topic 146) is fine

Easy local development important?
├─ YES → Prefect (Topic 146B)
└─ NO  → Airflow (Topic 146)

Already using Kubernetes?
└─ YES → Consider Kubeflow (Topic 147)

Large existing Airflow infrastructure?
└─ YES → Stay with Airflow (Topic 146)
```

### Do You Need a Feature Store?

```
Multiple models sharing features?
├─ YES → Implement Feast (Topic 148)
└─ NO  → Continue below

Training/serving skew problems?
├─ YES → Implement Feast (Topic 148)
└─ NO  → Continue below

Large team collaborating on features?
├─ YES → Implement Feast (Topic 148)
└─ NO  → Simple feature pipelines OK
```

sections.title: Command Snippets
sections.body:
### Docker
```bash
# Build
docker build -t ml-api:v1 .

# Run
docker run -p 8000:8000 ml-api:v1

# Compose
docker-compose up -d
```

### Kubernetes
```bash
# Apply
kubectl apply -f deployment.yaml

# Scale
kubectl scale deployment ml-api --replicas=5

# Status
kubectl get pods
kubectl logs <pod-name>
```

### Prefect
```bash
# Start server
prefect server start

# Run flow
python ml_pipeline.py

# Deploy
prefect deployment build-from-flow
```

### Feast
```bash
# Initialize
feast apply

# Materialize
feast materialize-incremental $(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S")

# UI
feast ui
```

### Kafka
```bash
# Start cluster
docker-compose up -d

# Create topic
kafka-topics.sh --create --topic ml-input --bootstrap-server localhost:9092

# Run consumer
python stream_processor.py
```

sections.title: Performance Benchmarks
sections.body:
### Communication Protocols
| Protocol | Latency | Throughput | Payload Size |
|----------|---------|------------|--------------|
| REST     | 50ms    | 1,000/s    | 500 bytes    |
| gRPC     | 7ms     | 7,000/s    | 50 bytes     |
| WebSocket| 10ms    | 5,000/s    | 100 bytes    |
| Kafka    | 2ms     | 100,000/s  | Variable     |

### Model Optimization
| Technique     | Size Reduction | Speed Increase | Accuracy Loss |
|---------------|----------------|----------------|---------------|
| INT8 Quant    | 4×             | 2-4×           | <1%           |
| Pruning (70%) | 3×             | 1.5×           | <2%           |
| Distillation  | 10×            | 5×             | 1-3%          |
| ONNX Runtime  | -              | 1.5-2×         | 0%            |
| TensorRT      | -              | 3-5×           | 0%            |

sections.title: Top 10 Production Tips
sections.body:
1. **Always version models** - Use semantic versioning (Topic 134)
2. **Monitor everything** - Data drift, performance, latency (Topic 149-151)
3. **Use async for scale** - Non-blocking APIs handle spikes (Topic 130D)
4. **Optimize before deploy** - Quantize + prune = 4× smaller (Topic 131)
5. **Feature stores for consistency** - Eliminate train/serve skew (Topic 148)
6. **Canary deploys** - Gradual rollout reduces risk (Topic 135-136)
7. **Kubernetes HPA** - Auto-scale based on traffic (Topic 143)
8. **CI/CD is mandatory** - Automate testing and deployment (Topic 144-145)
9. **Use gRPC for microservices** - 7× faster than REST (Topic 130B)
10. **Log everything** - Structured logs + tracing (Topic 163)
